command: node --import apps/desktop/scripts/test-env.mjs --import apps/desktop/scripts/test-tsx.mjs benchmarks/rust-core/recorders/record-phone-worktree.mjs --tree <git archive of b6f10295a2f698afc85332467192de28500bd146 with node_modules>

entry.notRun: the relay transport (encryption, admission) and the window process; the daemon runs without memory worker and MCP servers (MIXDOG_DAEMON_SKIP_MEMORY, MIXDOG_DISABLE_MCP), with the supervisor binary the real-turn harness cached
entry.runs: executeRemoteFrame over createRemoteMethods (remote-methods.ts:828, :1256) with SessionHost (session-host.ts) attached to the tree's own daemon (session-client.mjs ensureDaemon, attachSession; session-protocol.mjs createSessionProtocolClient), one world and one daemon per group

normalized.session: the session's own id is <session> in every answer (each product makes its own)
normalized.snapshot: a non-value-only answer's session snapshot is <snapshot>: the page reads only .value of these calls (worktree-branch-model.ts invokeWorktree); the snapshot is the chat's (phone-chat-live)
normalized.time: a field named *At is <time> (the run time)

notRecorded.notProducible: a request that is no object, names no or an unknown capability, has args that are no array, or a session id that is no id: the page's invokeCapability always sends {capability, args, sessionId?} with a capability it names and a session id it holds, and those requests go to the group that owns invokeCapability itself

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder

syntheticInput.world: a git repository registered as a Project (main, feature, spare; the review group leaves a.txt changed), a folder that is no Project, and one idle project session created as the new task does (session.create {cwd, desktopSession}); fixed git identity and time for every commit
